title: Programmable launch partner attribution v1
description: Immutable display attribution derived by the launch service from the authenticated partner API principal. It is not creator input and does not establish a partnership fee, review, safety, liquidity, tradeability, or third-party index status.

website.description: Canonical HTTPS partner website, or null when the partner has no published website.

snapshotDigest.description: SHA-256 over the schema-version domain, a zero byte, and JCS of the six preceding fields. The digest field is excluded from its own preimage.
